description: Profile level picks sleeve weights; exclusions pick the funds. Exclusions only move weight sideways (same group) or down to cash, never up.

us_equity.label: US shares
us_equity.why: Broad market only; size, style and sector tilts are bets, not core holdings.

intl_developed_equity.label: International shares
intl_developed_equity.why: Single-country and single-region funds left out for concentration.

em_equity.label: Emerging market shares
em_equity.why: China, India and other single-country funds left out for concentration.

global_equity.label: Global shares
global_equity.why: Not allocated directly; only a fallback when the regional sleeves have no fund.

aggregate_bonds.label: Core bonds
aggregate_bonds.why: Core-plus and hedged global bond funds left out to keep the core simple.

treasuries.label: US government bonds
treasuries.why: Long government bonds fell over 20% in the snapshot window; not a safe sleeve.

inflation_linked.label: Inflation-linked bonds
inflation_linked.why: Short-term only, so the sleeve protects against inflation without rate risk.

corporate_bonds.label: Corporate bonds
corporate_bonds.why: Long-term corporates left out for rate risk.

sukuk.label: Sukuk
sukuk.why: Not allocated directly; the sharia fallback for every bond sleeve.

exclude_tickers.BITO: Bitcoin futures fund; the 38% 'yield' is futures roll distributions, not income.
exclude_tickers.BLOK: Blockchain company shares, not crypto exposure (flagged crypto in the universe).
exclude_tickers.NEAR: Short-term bond fund sitting in the cash sleeve.
